name: window.find
description: Find the first top-level window whose title matches the case-insensitive substring pattern. Returns `ERR not_found` if no window matches.

pattern.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against window titles. Same convention as `window.list --filter`.

x-implementations.name: enum_windows
x-implementations.description: Win32 `EnumWindows` walk; first window whose `GetWindowTextW` (or A) result contains the pattern (case-folded) is returned. Walk halts on first match.

windows-modern.description: EnumWindows + GetWindowTextW + case-fold compare. Returns the first visible top-level window whose title contains the pattern. Hidden windows are not searched (no `--all` flag here; use window.list for that).

windows-classic.description: EnumWindows + GetWindowTextW (NT 5+) or GetWindowTextA (NT 4 / 9x, transcoded to UTF-8) + case-fold compare. Same first-match semantics as modern.
